# NOVA AI Video Studio

> NOVA is an AI-powered video and image generation platform focused on ecommerce product ads, UGC creatives, TikTok/Reels/Shorts, and social media content.

## What is NOVA?

NOVA AI Video Studio (novvideos.online) is a multi-model AI generation platform that gives creators and ecommerce brands access to the world's best AI video and image models in one place. Users can generate product videos, UGC-style ads, cinematic clips, and social media creatives without technical skills.

## Who is NOVA for?

- Ecommerce brands (Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce)
- Social media creators and marketers
- TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts creators
- Agencies creating video ads at scale

## Video Models Available

- Seedance 2.0 — ByteDance flagship. Text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video.
- Kling 3.0 — Kuaishou pro-grade. Text-to-video, image-to-video.
- PixVerse V6 — Cinematic video generation. Image-to-video.
- Veo 3.1 — Google DeepMind. Text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video.
- Happy Horse — Alibaba creative AI. Text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video.
- Wan 2.2 — Open-source powerhouse. Text-to-video, image-to-video.
- Hunyuan Video — High-fidelity motion synthesis.
- Lucy (Decart) — Real-time world simulation.
- Kling Avatar — AI avatar and lipsync generation.

## Image Models Available

- FLUX Schnell, FLUX Dev, FLUX Pro 1.1, FLUX Ultra
- GPT Image 2 (OpenAI)
- Recraft V3, Ideogram V3, Stable Diffusion 3.5
- AuraFlow, HiDream I1, Sana, Kolors, Nano Banana 2

## Pricing

- Trial: 10 free credits, no credit card required
- Basic: 70 credits/month
- Plus: 500 credits/month
- Ultra: 3000 credits/month + unlimited images
- Business: 3000 credits/month + unlimited images

## Alternatives

NOVA is an alternative to Runway, Pika, InVideo, Kling AI, Veo, Luma AI, Sora.
NOVA focuses specifically on ecommerce product ads and social media creatives.
